title: Deeper/broader peer-route capability, coverage, and consumer handoff review

method.kind: Primary-source documentation, release-note, and source review
localSourceInspected: dwg2dxf/main.cpp: FreeCAD-compatible input -o output CLI mode

sources.finding: LibreDWG documents broad version coverage but lists enabled/undertested classes, missing test-coverage families, and no DWG R2007 writer. These are project-authored scope statements, not independent qualification.
LibreDWG 0.14.1 NEWS records recent security, DXB, and writer work; this does not prove matching libdxfrw defects or semantic support.
The published compatibility matrix marks DWG writing unavailable at AC1021 while listing other releases; the matrix does not establish per-class completeness or runtime parity.
Documents ACadSharp's DWG/DXF reader API and notifications, useful for route setup but not a test result.
Documents ASCII and Binary DXF loading and a separate recovery path for flawed files.
Documents audit/recovery and raw ACIS SAT/SAB browsing/export as distinct tools; raw carrier visibility is not B-rep validation.
The current wrapper converts DWG to DXF using a selected external converter and passes the result to importDXF.open; the selected converter may be LibreDWG, ODA, or QCAD.
FreeCAD documents a native C++ DXF importer that does not implement all DXF features, an optional legacy Python route, and external DWG converters.
Describes DWG-to-DXF conversion followed by FreeCAD's standard DXF import path; this is not direct DWG parsing by FreeCAD.

localObservations: tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py contains generated tests for FreeCAD-shaped and conventional CLI forms.
Source/test inspection was read-only in this review; no test execution is reported.

readinessRefinements: Keep LibreDWG reader/writer and class coverage scoped by exact version and family; its self-reported coverage is not a universal oracle.
Do not use ACadSharp DWG writer as an AC1021 comparator; key any outcome by version, operation, family, and exact release.
Separate ezdxf strict DXF parse, recovery/audit, and raw SAT/SAB inspection from semantic B-rep and native-consumer evidence.
Separate libdxfrw CLI output, FreeCAD's configured DWG converter route, and FreeCAD's selected DXF importer result.
Keep fast per-slice tests local; run pinned peer and native routes only at the existing composed checkpoint.

limitations: Peer capability statements and release notes are not runtime conformance results.
No FreeCAD, peer, geometry kernel, or native application was run.
No peer artifact or external drawing was downloaded or inspected.
No support claim or deferred-external disposition is changed.
